reason.CREDENTIAL_REQUEST: A request for login details can expose an account to unauthorized access.
reason.CREATE_ORDER_FOR_THEM: Placing an order for someone else can conceal fraud or move stolen goods.
reason.UPFRONT_FEE: A fee before work or a reward may be an attempt to take your money.
reason.ROMANCE_MONEY: A romantic contact asking for money may be using a false relationship.
reason.MONEY_REVERSAL: A claim that money was sent by mistake can pressure you to return funds.
reason.PRIZE_WIN: An unexpected prize claim may be used to request money or personal details.
reason.LOOKALIKE_LINK: A link resembling a known service may lead to a page that collects details.
reason.SECRECY: A demand to keep the conversation secret can prevent helpful outside advice.
reason.TOO_GOOD_PAY: Unusually high pay for simple work can be used to attract job applicants.
reason.IMPERSONATION: Someone may be pretending to represent a person or organization you recognize.
reason.RISKY_PAYMENT_METHOD: Some payment methods make it difficult to recover money after a transfer.
reason.SHORTENED_LINK: A shortened link hides its destination until it is opened.
reason.URGENCY: Pressure to act quickly can make it harder to check a request carefully.
reason.OFF_PLATFORM: Moving a conversation away from a service can remove its reporting protections.
reason.RECENT_RISKY_MESSAGE: A recent concerning message may be related to this payment request.
reason.AMOUNT_SPIKE: This payment is much larger than the earlier amounts in your history.
reason.RAPID_REPEAT: Several payments close together can indicate unusual transfer activity.
reason.NEW_RECIPIENT: This recipient has not appeared in your earlier payment history.
reason.FIRST_LARGE: This is a large payment to a recipient with no previous payment history.
reason.FEE_LIKE_AMOUNT: The amount resembles a fee that may be requested to release money or a prize.
reason.ODD_HOUR: The payment time is outside the hours you usually make payments.
steps.job_scam.1: Verify the employer and role through a source you find independently.
steps.job_scam.2: Do not pay a fee or buy equipment to secure the position.
steps.job_scam.3: Pause before handling money, parcels, or orders for a recruiter.
steps.phishing.1: Open the service through its official app or a saved bookmark instead of the message link.
steps.phishing.2: Do not share a password or one-time code in reply to the message.
steps.phishing.3: If you shared account details, change your password through the official service.
steps.romance_scam.1: Talk with someone you trust before sending money or gifts.
steps.romance_scam.2: Do not send money to someone you have not met in person.
steps.romance_scam.3: Use the platform's report controls if the account or request seems deceptive.
steps.mobile_money_reversal.1: Check your balance and transaction history in the official payment app.
steps.mobile_money_reversal.2: Do not return a payment based only on a message or screenshot.
steps.mobile_money_reversal.3: Contact your payment provider through its official app or documents.
steps.prize_scam.1: Check the prize rules through the organizer's official channel.
steps.prize_scam.2: Do not pay an advance fee to claim a prize.
steps.prize_scam.3: Avoid sharing identity or account details to collect an unexpected award.
steps.impersonation.1: Contact the person or organization using contact details you already trust.
steps.impersonation.2: Do not transfer money or share codes until the request is confirmed independently.
steps.impersonation.3: Report the message through the impersonated service's official channel.
steps.mule_request.1: Do not receive or forward money or parcels for someone you do not know.
steps.mule_request.2: Pause and ask a trusted person to review the request with you.
steps.mule_request.3: If you already transferred funds, contact your payment provider promptly.
